title: 1/2 day tour
text:
Half day tour.  Was supposed to be walking tour and then to the mountain.  Was opposite and was very hot walking during afternoon.  Began tour at 9am.
Guide was Lisa?  So hot for her.
author: KatherineI28

title: 5 stars for Nuria and Barcelona.
text: Nuria was our guide and she was absolutely great. We saw all the great sites and she kept us entertained and informed and she had many great side stories that were captivating. Like stories about Barcelona curiosities and the Catalan language and places to enjoy as tourists and things to avoid. Great cultural tidbits about each site. Even a romantic story about St. Jordi and the dragon. It was just a wonderful experience.
author: bobbQ8230UI

title: We would definitely recommend discovering Barcelona with Julia Travel!
text:
We did the tour with the lovely Nouria – a very kind and beautiful lady. You could immediately notice how passionate she is about Barcelona and that she has great knowledge about the city. She explained everything perfectly in English, which was very helpful for us since we came from Germany.

At the end of the tour, she also gave us some personal tips about places she recommends in Barcelona, which we really appreciated.

We would definitely recommend discovering Barcelona with Julia Travel!
author: Anna-Laura M

title: Barcelona with Sara!
text: Our experience with Sara as a guide was amazing! She described the architecture beautifully and was entertaining as well! Highly recommend this tour and Sara as your guide! She loves her city!

title: Highly Recommend!
